Humans' bridged and high noses is a climate adaptation. Most primates live in the tropics and have wide flat noses and big nostrils to keep the brain cool and same applies for many humans indigenous to the tropics. High noses with narrow nostrils warm air before it hits the sinus and this adaptation is for cold climates. High noses with wide nostrils add humidity to air and this is an adaptation for arid climate.
